sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story metadata declarations, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across iconic Glenn Miller swing broadcasts featuring *"In the Mood"* for Chesterfield, federal moonshine still crackdowns on *Treasury Agent*, two-part hardboiled private detective capers at the World Series on South Africa's Springbok Radio, early 1930s department store man-hunter investigations on *Eno Crime Clues*, and vintage Texas college gridiron previews, Glenn Miller (1943), Knox Manning (1956), *Dameron* (1973), Spencer Dean (1934), and WACO sports (1934–1973):
